metrics.name: Possession
metrics.description: Our share of the time the ball was in play.

metrics.name: Pass completion
metrics.description: Completed passes over all passes.

metrics.name: Press intensity (PPDA)
metrics.description: Their passes in their own 60% of the pitch for each defensive action of ours there. Lower is a harder press.

metrics.name: Defensive line height
metrics.description: Out of possession, the average distance of our four deepest outfield players from our goal line.

metrics.name: Width in possession
metrics.description: In possession, the distance between our widest outfield players.

metrics.name: Team length out of possession
metrics.description: Out of possession, from our deepest to our highest outfield player. Lower is more compact.

metrics.name: Field tilt
metrics.description: Our share of the completed passes into or inside either final third.

metrics.name: Counter-press regains
metrics.description: Of the times we lost the ball, how often we won it back within 5 seconds.

metrics.name: High regains per 90
metrics.description: Times we won the ball within 40 m of their goal, per 90 minutes.

metrics.name: Final-third entries down the left
metrics.description: Of our passes and carries into the final third, the share down our left channel.

metrics.name: Final-third entries through the middle
metrics.description: Of our passes and carries into the final third, the share through the middle.

metrics.name: Final-third entries down the right
metrics.description: Of our passes and carries into the final third, the share down our right channel.

metrics.name: Goal kicks played short
metrics.description: Of our goal kicks, the share played short (under 32 m).

metrics.name: Shots conceded per 90
metrics.description: Their shots, per 90 minutes.

metrics.name: Our xG per 90
metrics.description: The expected goals of our shots, per 90 minutes.

metrics.name: xG conceded per 90
metrics.description: The expected goals of their shots, per 90 minutes.

metrics.name: Set pieces: first contact won
metrics.description: Of our deliveries into the box (corners, free kicks within 35 m, long throws), the share where we won the first contact.

metrics.name: Defending set pieces: first contact
metrics.description: Of their deliveries into our box, the share where we won the first contact (or nobody did).

metrics.name: Set-piece xG per 90
metrics.description: The expected goals of our shots in the 8 seconds after a set piece, per 90 minutes.

metrics.name: Set-piece xG conceded per 90
metrics.description: The expected goals of their shots in the 8 seconds after a set piece, per 90 minutes.

metrics.name: High-speed running per 90
metrics.description: All our players' running over 5.5 m/s (19.8 km/h), per 90 minutes.

metrics.name: Sprints per 90
metrics.description: All our players' efforts over 7 m/s (25.2 km/h), per 90 minutes.

metrics.name: Running drop (any player)
metrics.description: The biggest drop in ground covered per minute among our outfield players: each one's last 15' against his own first 30'. A player on for less than two thirds of the stretch, or for less than 20 of the first 30', doesn't count.
